Apply only after the control foundation and complete review.\\r\\n-- No deployment authorization. Configuration starts disabled with no lease.\\r\\nbegin;\\r\\ncreate table public.timed_content_manifests_v1 (\\r\\n  manifest_sha256 text not null check(manifest_sha256 ~ \'^[a-f0-9]{64}$\'),\\r\\n  pt integer not null,\\r\\n  blueprint jsonb not null check(jsonb_typeof(blueprint)=\'object\'),\\r\\n  primary key(manifest_sha256,pt)\\r\\n);\\r\\ncreate table public.timed_pt_configuration_v1 (\\r\\n  singleton boolean primary key default true check(singleton),\\r\\n  enabled boolean not null default false,\\r\\n  manifest_sha256 text,\\r\\n  lease_ms integer,\\r\\n  check(not enabled or (manifest_sha256 ~ \'^[a-f0-9]{64}$\' and lease_ms>0) is true)\\r\\n);\\r\\ninsert into public.timed_pt_configuration_v1(singleton) values(true);\\r\\nalter table public.practice_test_runs add column timed_manifest_sha256 text,\\r\\n  add column timed_manifest jsonb;\\r\\nalter table public.practice_test_runs add constraint timed_pt_manifest_pair_v1 check(\\r\\n  (timed_contract_version is null and timed_manifest_sha256 is null and timed_manifest is null)\\r\\n  or (timed_contract_version=1 and timed_manifest_sha256 ~ \'^[a-f0-9]{64}$\'\\r\\n    and jsonb_typeof(timed_manifest)=\'object\'\\r\\n    and timed_manifest->>\'pt\'=pt::text\\r\\n    and timed_frozen_legs=public.timed_pt_leg_definitions_v1(timed_manifest->\'legs\')) is true\\r\\n);\\r\\n-- New protected attempts have stable source attribution; legacy attempts stay null.\\r\\nalter table public.attempts add column timed_pt_run_id text, add column timed_pt_leg integer;\\r\\nalter table public.attempts add constraint timed_lr_attempt_pair_v1 check(\\r\\n  (timed_pt_run_id is null)=(timed_pt_leg is null));\\r\\nalter table public.attempts add constraint timed_lr_attempt_owner_v1 check(\\r\\n  timed_pt_run_id is null or user_id is not null);\\r\\nalter table public.attempts add constraint timed_lr_attempt_parent_v1 foreign key(timed_pt_run_id,user_id)\\r\\n  references public.practice_test_runs(id,user_id);\\r\\ncreate unique index timed_lr_attempt_once_v1 on public.attempts(timed_pt_run_id,timed_pt_leg,qid)\\r\\n  where timed_pt_run_id is not null;\\r\\n\\r\\nalter table public.timed_content_manifests_v1 enable row level security;\\r\\nalter table public.timed_pt_configuration_v1 enable row level security;\\r\\nrevoke all on public.timed_content_manifests_v1,public.timed_pt_configuration_v1 from public,anon,authenticated;\\r\\ngrant select on public.timed_content_manifests_v1 to timed_pt_executor;\\r\\n-- SELECT FOR SHARE requires UPDATE privilege; no UPDATE RLS policy is granted.\\r\\ngrant select,update on public.timed_pt_configuration_v1 to timed_pt_executor;\\r\\ncreate policy manifest_executor_read on public.timed_content_manifests_v1 for select to timed_pt_executor using(true);\\r\\ncreate policy configuration_executor_read on public.timed_pt_configuration_v1 for select to timed_pt_executor using(true);\\r\\ncreate policy configuration_executor_lock on public.timed_pt_configuration_v1 for update to timed_pt_executor using(true) with check(false);\\r\\n\\r\\n-- Grant-row share locks conflict with updates/deletes by ordinary revocation\\r\\n-- paths. Parent -> administrator row -> profile row -> exact assignment order.\\r\\ncreate function public.timed_pt_require_access_v1(p_owner uuid,p_pt integer) returns void\\r\\nlanguage plpgsql set search_path=pg_catalog,public as $$\\r\\nbegin\\r\\n  perform 1 from public.user_roles where user_id=p_owner and role::text=\'admin\' order by id for share;\\r\\n  if found then return; end if;\\r\\n  perform 1 from public.profiles where class_id=p_owner::text and has_practice_access for share;\\r\\n  if found then return; end if;\\r\\n  perform 1 from public.practice_test_assignments where student_id=p_owner and pt=p_pt\\r\\n    and status<>\'archived\' and (unlock_at is null or unlock_at<=clock_timestamp()) for share;\\r\\n  if found then return; end if;\\r\\n  raise exception \'Practice test access unavailable\' using errcode=\'PT401\';\\r\\nend $$;\\r\\n\\r\\ncreate function public.timed_pt_check_keys_v1(p_value jsonb,p_keys text[]) returns void\\r\\nlanguage plpgsql immutable set search_path=pg_catalog as $$\\r\\nbegin\\r\\n  if jsonb_typeof(p_value) is distinct from \'object\' or exists(\\r\\n    select 1 from jsonb_object_keys(p_value) k where not k=any(p_keys)) then\\r\\n    raise exception \'Unknown command fields\' using errcode=\'PT422\';\\r\\n  end if;\\r\\nend $$;\\r\\n\\r\\ncreate function public.timed_pt_checkpoint_v1(p_run public.practice_test_runs) returns jsonb\\r\\nlanguage plpgsql set search_path=pg_catalog,public as $$\\r\\ndeclare b public.timed_pt_lr_bindings_v1; s public.rc_drill_sessions;\\r\\nbegin\\r\\n  select * into b from public.timed_pt_lr_bindings_v1 where run_id=p_run.id and leg_index=p_run.current_leg;\\r\\n  if found then\\r\\n    return (select jsonb_build_object(\'kind\',\'lr\',\'record\',data) from public.bootcamp_kv\\r\\n      where user_id=p_run.user_id and table_name=b.namespace and record_id=b.record_id);\\r\\n  end if;\\r\\n  select * into s from public.rc_drill_sessions where practice_test_run_id=p_run.id\\r\\n    and practice_test_leg=p_run.current_leg and user_id=p_run.user_id;\\r\\n  if found then return jsonb_build_object(\'kind\',\'rc\',\'session\',to_jsonb(s),\'attempts\',\\r\\n    coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) order by a.question_id) from public.rc_attempts a\\r\\n      where a.session_id=s.id and a.user_id=p_run.user_id),\'[]\'::jsonb)); end if;\\r\\n  return null;\\r\\nend $$;\\r\\n\\r\\ncreate function public.timed_pt_response_v1(p_run public.practice_test_runs,p_receipt public.timed_pt_receipts_v1,p_replayed boolean)\\r\\nreturns jsonb language sql set search_path=pg_catalog,public as $$\\r\\n  select jsonb_build_object(\'receipt\',jsonb_build_object(\'ownerId\',p_receipt.owner_id,\\r\\n    \'workKind\',p_receipt.work_kind,\'workId\',p_receipt.work_id,\'commandId\',p_receipt.command_id,\\r\\n    \'operation\',p_receipt.canonical_command->>\'operation\',\'command\',p_receipt.canonical_command,\\r\\n    \'committedRevision\',p_receipt.committed_revision,\'result\',p_receipt.committed_result),\\r\\n    \'parent\',to_jsonb(p_run),\'checkpoint\',public.timed_pt_checkpoint_v1(p_run),\\r\\n    \'serverTime\',clock_timestamp(),\'replayed\',p_replayed)\\r\\n$$;\\r\\n\\r\\ncreate function public.timed_practice_test_capability_v1() returns jsonb\\r\\nlanguage sql security definer set search_path=pg_catalog,public as $$\\r\\n  select jsonb_build_object(\'contractVersion\',1,\'workKind\',\'practice-test\',\'enabled\',\\r\\n    auth.uid() is not null and coalesce((select enabled from public.timed_pt_configuration_v1 where singleton),false),\\r\\n    \'operations\',jsonb_build_array(\'read\',\'create\',\'claim\',\'start-leg\',\'checkpoint\',\'heartbeat\',\'pause\',\'resume\',\'close-leg\',\'start-break\',\'finish-break\',\'abandon\'))\\r\\n$$;\\r\\n\\r\\ncreate function public.create_timed_practice_test_v1(p_command jsonb) returns jsonb\\r\\nlanguage plpgsql security definer set search_path=pg_catalog,public as $$\\r\\ndeclare actor uuid:=auth.uid(); c public.timed_pt_configuration_v1; r public.practice_test_runs;\\r\\n  rec public.timed_pt_receipts_v1; manifest jsonb; legs jsonb; payload jsonb:=p_command->\'payload\';\\r\\n  cid uuid; work_id text:=p_command->>\'workId\'; pace text:=payload->>\'pace\'; seconds integer;\\r\\nbegin\\r\\n  if actor is null then raise exception \'Authentication required\' using errcode=\'PT401\'; end if;\\r\\n  perform public.timed_pt_check_keys_v1(p_command,array[\'workKind\',\'workId\',\'commandId\',\'deviceId\',\'expectedRevision\',\'writerEpoch\',\'operation\',\'payload\']);\\r\\n  perform public.timed_pt_check_keys_v1(payload,array[\'pt\',\'pace\',\'sectionSeconds\']);\\r\\n  if p_command->>\'workKind\' is distinct from \'practice-test\' or p_command->>\'operation\' is distinct from \'create\'\\r\\n    or jsonb_typeof(p_command->\'workId\') is distinct from \'string\' or jsonb_typeof(p_command->\'deviceId\') is distinct from \'string\'\\r\\n    or jsonb_typeof(p_command->\'commandId\') is distinct from \'string\'\\r\\n    or jsonb_typeof(p_command->\'expectedRevision\') is distinct from \'number\' or jsonb_typeof(p_command->\'writerEpoch\') is distinct from \'number\'\\r\\n    or jsonb_typeof(payload->\'pt\') is distinct from \'number\' or payload->>\'pt\' !~ \'^[0-9]+$\'\\r\\n    or jsonb_typeof(payload->\'pace\') is distinct from \'string\'\\r\\n    or not payload ? \'sectionSeconds\' or (pace<>\'untimed\' and (jsonb_typeof(payload->\'sectionSeconds\') is distinct from \'number\' or payload->>\'sectionSeconds\' !~ \'^[0-9]+$\'))\\r\\n    or (pace=\'untimed\' and jsonb_typeof(payload->\'sectionSeconds\') is distinct from \'null\')\\r\\n    or coalesce(length(work_id),0) not between 1 and 128 or work_id like \'%::%\'\\r\\n    or coalesce(length(p_command->>\'deviceId\'),0) not between 1 and 128\\r\\n    or p_command->>\'expectedRevision\' is distinct from \'0\' or p_command->>\'writerEpoch\' is distinct from \'0\'\\r\\n    or pace is null or pace not in (\'standard\',\'time-and-a-half\',\'double-time\',\'untimed\') then\\r\\n    raise exception \'Invalid creation envelope\' using errcode=\'PT422\'; end if;\\r\\n  cid:=(p_command->>\'commandId\')::uuid;\\r\\n  if cid is null then raise exception \'Command identity required\' using errcode=\'PT422\'; end if;\\r\\n  -- Serialize missing-row creation as well as subsequent row commands.\\r\\n  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(actor::text||\'::\'||work_id,0));\\r\\n  select * into r from public.practice_test_runs where id=work_id and user_id=actor for update;\\r\\n  if found then\\r\\n    select * into rec from public.timed_pt_receipts_v1 receipt where receipt.owner_id=actor and receipt.work_kind=\'practice-test\'\\r\\n      and receipt.work_id=r.id and receipt.command_id=cid;\\r\\n    if found then\\r\\n      if rec.canonical_command<>p_command then raise exception \'Changed command replay\' using errcode=\'PT409\'; end if;\\r\\n      return public.timed_pt_response_v1(r,rec,true);\\r\\n    end if;\\r\\n    raise exception \'Work identity already exists\' using errcode=\'PT409\';\\r\\n  end if;\\r\\n  select * into c from public.timed_pt_configuration_v1 where singleton for share;\\r\\n  if not coalesce(c.enabled,false) then raise exception \'Timed writer inactive\' using errcode=\'PT503\'; end if;\\r\\n  perform public.timed_pt_require_access_v1(actor,(payload->>\'pt\')::integer);\\r\\n  select blueprint into manifest from public.timed_content_manifests_v1 where manifest_sha256=c.manifest_sha256\\r\\n    and pt=(payload->>\'pt\')::integer;\\r\\n  if manifest is null or jsonb_array_length(manifest->\'legs\')<>3 or manifest->>\'breakAfterLeg\'<>\'2\'\\r\\n    or manifest->>\'breakSeconds\'<>\'600\' then raise exception \'Supported manifest unavailable\' using errcode=\'PT422\'; end if;\\r\\n  legs:=public.timed_pt_leg_definitions_v1(manifest->\'legs\');\\r\\n  seconds:=(payload->>\'sectionSeconds\')::integer;\\r\\n  if (pace=\'untimed\' and seconds is not null) or (pace<>\'untimed\' and coalesce(seconds,0)<=0) then\\r\\n    raise exception \'Invalid chosen timing\' using errcode=\'PT422\'; end if;\\r\\n  insert into public.practice_test_runs(id,user_id,pt,pace,legs,break_after_leg,status,section_seconds,\\r\\n    active_device_id,timed_contract_version,timed_writer_epoch,timed_phase,timed_elapsed_ms,timed_lease_ms,\\r\\n    timed_frozen_legs,timed_manifest_sha256,timed_manifest)\\r\\n  values(work_id,actor,(payload->>\'pt\')::integer,pace,legs,2,\'in-progress\',seconds,\\r\\n    p_command->>\'deviceId\',1,1,\'ready\',0,c.lease_ms,legs,c.manifest_sha256,manifest) returning * into r;\\r\\n  insert into public.timed_pt_receipts_v1(owner_id,work_kind,work_id,command_id,canonical_command,committed_revision,committed_result)\\r\\n    values(actor,\'practice-test\',r.id,cid,p_command,r.revision,jsonb_build_object(\'operation\',\'create\')) returning * into rec;\\r\\n  return public.timed_pt_response_v1(r,rec,false);\\r\\nexception when invalid_text_representation or numeric_value_out_of_range then\\r\\n  raise exception \'Invalid typed creation value\' using errcode=\'PT422\';\\r\\nend $$;\\r\\n\\r\\n-- Actual child enforcement tests both OLD and NEW attribution. Invoker role is\\r\\n-- exact, while definer RPCs run as the dedicated executor. SHARE locks serialize\\r\\n-- legacy child preflights with later parent adoption (which is not exposed yet).\\r\\ncreate function public.guard_timed_pt_child_v1() returns trigger\\r\\nlanguage plpgsql set search_path=pg_catalog,public as $$\\r\\ndeclare item jsonb; run_id text; protected boolean:=false; binding public.timed_pt_lr_bindings_v1;\\r\\nbegin\\r\\n  for item in select v from (values(case when TG_OP<>\'INSERT\' then to_jsonb(OLD) end),\\r\\n      (case when TG_OP<>\'DELETE\' then to_jsonb(NEW) end)) x(v) where v is not null loop\\r\\n    run_id:=null;\\r\\n    if TG_TABLE_NAME=\'practice_test_runs\' then\\r\\n      if item->>\'timed_contract_version\' is not null then protected:=true; end if;\\r\\n    elsif TG_TABLE_NAME in (\'section_history\',\'rc_drill_sessions\') then\\r\\n      run_id:=item->>\'practice_test_run_id\';\\r\\n      if TG_TABLE_NAME=\'rc_drill_sessions\' and item->\'config\'->>\'practiceTestRunId\' is not null then\\r\\n        protected:=protected or public.timed_pt_parent_protected_v1(item->\'config\'->>\'practiceTestRunId\'); end if;\\r\\n    elsif TG_TABLE_NAME=\'attempts\' then run_id:=item->>\'timed_pt_run_id\';\\r\\n    elsif TG_TABLE_NAME=\'rc_attempts\' then\\r\\n      select practice_test_run_id into run_id from public.rc_drill_sessions where id=(item->>\'session_id\')::uuid;\\r\\n    elsif TG_TABLE_NAME=\'bootcamp_kv\' then\\r\\n      select * into binding from public.timed_pt_lr_bindings_v1 where owner_id=(item->>\'user_id\')::uuid\\r\\n        and namespace=item->>\'table_name\' and record_id=item->>\'record_id\';\\r\\n      if found then run_id:=binding.run_id; end if;\\r\\n      if item->>\'table_name\'=\'practice_sessions\' then\\r\\n        if item->\'data\'->>\'pool_slug\' like \'drill::practice-test::%\' and\\r\\n          public.timed_pt_parent_protected_v1(split_part(item->\'data\'->>\'pool_slug\',\'::\',3)) then protected:=true; end if;\\r\\n        if item->\'data\'->>\'completion_id\' like \'drill::practice-test::%\' and\\r\\n          public.timed_pt_parent_protected_v1(split_part(item->\'data\'->>\'completion_id\',\'::\',3)) then protected:=true; end if;\\r\\n      end if;\\r\\n    end if;\\r\\n    if run_id is not null then\\r\\n      protected:=protected or public.timed_pt_parent_protected_v1(run_id);\\r\\n    end if;\\r\\n    if coalesce(protected,false) and current_user<>\'timed_pt_executor\' then\\r\\n      raise exception \'Protected child requires the timed writer\' using errcode=\'42501\'; end if;\\r\\n    if coalesce(protected,false) and TG_TABLE_NAME=\'rc_drill_sessions\' and\\r\\n      (item->\'config\'->>\'practiceTestRunId\' is distinct from run_id or item->\'config\'->>\'practiceTestLegIndex\' is distinct from item->>\'practice_test_leg\') then\\r\\n      raise exception \'Contradictory protected RC attribution\' using errcode=\'PT422\'; end if;\\r\\n    if coalesce(protected,false) and TG_OP=\'DELETE\' then raise exception \'Protected child history retained\' using errcode=\'42501\'; end if;\\r\\n  end loop;\\r\\n  if TG_TABLE_NAME=\'practice_test_runs\' then\\r\\n    if TG_OP=\'UPDATE\' and OLD.timed_contract_version is not null and\\r\\n      (NEW.timed_manifest_sha256 is distinct from OLD.timed_manifest_sha256 or NEW.timed_manifest is distinct from OLD.timed_manifest) then\\r\\n      raise exception \'Frozen manifest immutable\' using errcode=\'42501\'; end if;\\r\\n  end if;\\r\\n  if TG_OP=\'DELETE\' then return OLD; end if; return NEW;\\r\\nend $$;\\r\\ncreate trigger timed_manifest_guard before update on public.practice_test_runs for each row execute function public.guard_timed_pt_child_v1();\\r\\ncreate trigger timed_kv_guard before insert or update or delete on public.bootcamp_kv for each row execute function public.guard_timed_pt_child_v1();\\r\\ncreate trigger timed_lr_attempt_guard before insert or update or delete on public.attempts for each row execute function public.guard_timed_pt_child_v1();\\r\\ncreate trigger timed_history_guard before insert or update or delete on public.section_history for each row execute function public.guard_timed_pt_child_v1();\\r\\n"}'}]

cid:=(p_command->>\'commandId\')::uuid;\\r\\n  if cid is null then raise exception \'Command identity required\' using errcode=\'PT422\'; end if;\\r\\n  select * into r from public.practice_test_runs ## assistant

Prepared the isolated v1 transport and parent adapter in four new source/test files, plus a readiness note.

- Native owner/run Web Locks serialize durable queue mutations.
- Lost replies retain the exact command.
- Definite typed denials support deliberate archival before a fresh claim.
- Receipts, full manifests, checkpoints, and authoritative revisions are validated.
- Parent clocks use monotonic elapsed time bounded by the server lease.

56 focused tests, ESLint, and full typecheck pass. No existing adapters/UI activated or backend deployed.

Independent backend review found no material defect. Live deployment compatibility and production acceptance remain unverified; the fresh catalog also omits assignment-table columns/policies.

- After a successful `create_thread` call, emit `::created-thread{threadId="..."}` for a created thread or `::created-thread{clientThreadId="..."}` for queued worktree setup on its own line in your final response.

### Inline Code Comments
- Use the ::code-comment{...} directive when you need to attach feedback directly to specific code lines.
- Emit one directive per inline comment; emit none when there are no actionable inline comments.
- Required attributes: title (short label), body (one-paragraph explanation), file (path to the file).
- Optional attributes: start, end (1-based line numbers), priority (0-3).
- file should be an absolute path or include the workspace folder segment so it can be resolved relative to the workspace.
- Keep line ranges tight; end defaults to start.
- Example: ::code-comment{title="[P2] Off-by-one" body="Loop iterates past the end when length is 0." file="/path/to/foo.ts" start=10 end=11 priority=2}

### Inline Artifact Follow-Ups
- Format each artifact follow-up as an unescaped Markdown list item, `- :codex-followup[visible phrase]{prompt="Complete user request"}`; avoid closing brackets in the visible phrase and escape double quotes in the prompt.

### Git
- Branch prefix: `codex/`. Use this prefix by default when creating branches, but follow the user's request if they want a different prefix.
</app-context>

For requests to create or edit a standalone LaTeX document, use the built-in editor by default. Create or edit the .tex source with normal file tools, and open the saved file with open_in_codex unless it is already open or the user requests otherwise. Keep follow-up edits in that same file and editor. Use compile_latex_document after editing and fix source errors within its repair limits. Keep the editor open even when compilation fails; preserve the source and report unverified compilation or unsupported project requirements. Discover these tools if deferred. The native editor requires no LaTeX plugin or local TeX installation; do not install either for it. Ordinary math explanations stay in chat.

# Global rules — Joshua

These apply on **every** project on this machine, in every session. Project-level
`AGENTS.md` files add to this; they do not replace it.

Keep this file short. It reloads on every message.

---

Joshua Fisseha — `contact@aspiringattorneys.com`. Builds **LSAT U** (lsatprep.study) and
the Aspiring Attorneys brand. Teaches the LSAT: ~25 one-to-one sessions a week plus
consultations. Windows 11; a MacBook Pro runs some sessions too, so paths differ between
them — never assume `/Users/joshuaf/...` resolves here.

## Where things live

- **AI OS / second brain:** `C:\Users\Joshu\dev\ai-os` — the Obsidian vault. `context/`,

  shadcn, Supabase backend, hosted on Lovable.
- **GitHub:** account `vnjkoxpl-42905` (auto-generated name, correct account).

## How to work with him

- **Do the whole task.** Deliver the finished thing, then say plainly what you skipped
  and why. Don't hand back a plan when the work was asked for.
- **Look before asking.** If the answer is on disk or reachable through a connected tool,
  go get it. He has Firecrawl, Google Workspace (`gws`), and `gh` — use them.
- **Say what's actually true.** Distinguish verified from assumed, every time. If a step
  failed or was skipped, lead with that. A confident wrong answer costs more than "I
  don't know yet."
- **Surface your own mistakes immediately**, including scope errors you notice mid-task.
- Absolute dates (`YYYY-MM-DD`), never "yesterday" or "last week".
- Don't re-ask what he already answered. Don't pad with options he didn't request.

- **Dictation fixes.** A message shaped like `word --> word` (any arrow, any spacing), or
  "save X in my vocabulary", is a Superwhisper correction. Invoke the `superwhisper` skill
  and apply it in that turn, whatever else is in progress.

## Writing as Joshua

Anything published under his name — course copy, lessons, emails, posts.

Plain, direct, confident. Short sentences. Teach the reasoning rather than asserting the
conclusion; this is a teaching brand and the reasoning *is* the product. Concrete beats
abstract. Never condescend to the reader.

**Never use:** "delve into", "dive deep", "unlock", "unleash", "harness the power of",
"in today's fast-paced world", "ever-evolving landscape", "it's not just X, it's Y",
"navigate the complexities", "at the end of the day", "elevate", "supercharge",
"game-changer", "seamless", "robust", "I hope this helps!", "Great question!",
"Certainly!". No em-dash pile-ups. No paragraph opening with "Moreover," /
"Furthermore," / "Additionally,". No emoji in professional writing unless asked.

Headers should say something, not label a category — "Why students miss this", not
"Analysis".

## Safety

- **Draft by default; send only when he says "send".** Email, messages, posts are drafted
  and shown to him. When he says "send it" (or equivalent) in chat, send it, then log it in
  `wiki/send-ledger.md`. Never send on your own initiative, and never treat a request to
  draft as a request to send.
- **Never delete** files, emails, or records without explicit confirmation.
- The Google Workspace grant is broad (it includes deleting all Drive files), so the
  restraint has to live in tool permissions, not in wording. A prompt is not a permission
  layer.
- Secrets stay in `.env` and the OS keyring. Never paste a key into a note, a commit, or
  a chat.

## Tools already connected

- **Firecrawl** — CLI + 28 skills. Prefer it over MCP; the hosted MCP server was removed
  on purpose (the key would sit in plaintext in `~/.Codex.json`).
- **Google Workspace** — `gws` CLI, GCP project `ai-os-joshua`. Gmail, Calendar, Drive,

## Cost discipline

`AGENTS.md` reloads on every message, so keep this file lean. Prefer CLIs to MCP servers
(an MCP server can cost ~18k tokens per message in tool definitions). `/clear` between
unrelated tasks. Run the `handoff` skill past ~25% context rather than waiting for
auto-compact.

# Jay 2 — operating instructions for Codex (ai-os)

The canonical root is the repository directory containing this file (`C:\Users\Joshu\dev\ai-os` on this Windows machine). Resolve paths from the repository root instead of assuming a saved Mac or Windows absolute path. This is the router: it holds pointers, not knowledge. Read it, then follow the routing map to the right file instead of searching blind. Twin for Claude Code: `CLAUDE.md`.

## Identity and mission

You are **Jay 2**, Joshua's executive assistant. This root is his EA workspace and command center. Joshua is the founder of Aspiring Attorneys and builder of LSAT U (lsatprep.study), a premium LSAT prep platform; he is the product, voice, and content authority. Your job: take operations, admin, drafting, and research off his plate so his time goes to teaching and building. Frame work as decisions and tradeoffs, not basics.

Standing duties, run from here without re-briefing: student operations (transcripts, assignments, follow-ups via `students/`), prospect and consultation correspondence (drafted in his voice, **never auto-sent unless a pre-approved template**), platform actions on lsatprep.study, session-note ingestion from Gmail/Drive, and keeping the wiki ledgers (`tasks`/`hot`/`log`) current so the next session starts oriented.

## Routing map

Paths are relative to the repository root.

| Need | Path |
|---|---|
| **Who Joshua is** (identity, preferences, contact) | `context/about-me.md` |
| **The business** (offers, money, channels, gaps) | `context/work.md` |
| **Current priorities** (the 90-day slate) | `context/priorities.md` |
| **What we decided and why** (locked decisions) | `decisions/log.md` |
| Freshest session state (hot cache) | `wiki/hot.md` |
| LLM Wiki schema (source, page, ingest/query/lint rules) | `system/schema/llm-wiki.md` |
| Master index · work ledger · dated history | `wiki/index.md` · `wiki/tasks.md` · `wiki/log.md` |
| Product ground truth (pointers to live backends) | `wiki/dashboard.md` |
| LSAT teaching knowledge | `corpus/index.md` |
| A student — profile, transcripts, work, correspondence | `students/<name>/` — start at `students/README.md` |
| Voice for anything a student or prospect reads | `wiki/teaching-voice.md` |
| Was it sent? (every outbound draft/send) | `wiki/send-ledger.md` — append-only; Gmail is authority |
| Who the students are (name, email, sessions, links) | `students/roster.generated.md` — regenerate, never hand-edit |
| Learned facts and preferences (automemory) | native store `~/.claude/projects/C--Users-Joshu-dev-ai-os/memory/` + `MEMORY.md` index |
| Skill / agent catalog | `skills/INDEX.md`, `agents/` |
| Systems Jay 2 can reach (registry) | `connections.md` — 7 data domains, mechanism/auth/freshness; read by `/audit` |
| Operator brain (how to think about automation) | `references/3ms-framework.md` — the Three Ms; walked weekly by `/level-up` |
| Automation build backlog (what to build next, ranked) | `references/automation-backlog.md` — corpus-derived gaps + tiers; feeds `/level-up` |
| How-it-works reference notes (methods, not state) | `references/` — also `references/claude-plus-codex.md`, `references/obsidian-command-center.md`, `references/second-brain-levels.md` |
| Web research and Firecrawl agents | `references/firecrawl.md` (guidelines in `references/firecrawl/`) |
| Immutable source evidence · intake queue | `raw/sources/` · `raw/inbox/` — one inbox, one archive |
| Archived web clips, with provenance + hashes | `raw/sources/clips/<slug>/` — clip + `PROVENANCE.md` + `SHA256SUMS` |
| Raw personal-data exports (Google Takeout, Gemini session transcripts) | `raw/data-about-me/` — unprocessed PII, git-ignored; never read wholesale |
| Design/plan thinking, dated (grill-me + interview outputs) | `brainstorms/` — supersedes the retired `aios/` reform folder |
| Session handoffs · chat exports | `handoffs/` — operational records, deliberately OUTSIDE `raw/`; `session-handoff` writes here |
| External teardowns and research, dated | `research/` |
| Web-clipped articles (Obsidian Web Clipper) | `raw/inbox/` — unprocessed only; `ingest` copies and hash-verifies them into `raw/sources/clips/`; processed originals stay until removal is authorized |
| Application code | `../ai-os-projects/lsatu/` — own repo, own instructions, own remote |
| Other projects (life-path, …) | `../ai-os-projects/<name>/` — each with its own `CLAUDE.md` + `.claude/` |

Application repositories and dependencies stay outside this Obsidian vault, in sibling `../ai-os-projects/`. Do not create a junction from the vault back into that directory.

## Retrieval order

1. `wiki/hot.md` — current-session narrative and open threads.
2. `wiki/index.md` → the page (teaching knowledge: `corpus/index.md`; a student: their folder). Follow links; there is no semantic search and none is needed at this size.
3. The live system — the final freshness escalation.

**Live systems are authority for operational state; the brain mirrors them:** Cal.com + Google Calendar own sessions scheduled/used, LSAT U Supabase owns homework status/dossier/publish state, Stripe owns payment events, Gmail owns correspondence. On any disagreement, the backend wins. The brain is primary — nothing upstream holds them — for transcripts, teaching notes, judgments, prep briefs, curriculum, product specs, and decisions.

**Do not read the wiki unless the task needs it.** Retrieval costs context every turn. Skip it for: code edits in `../ai-os-projects/lsatu/`; shell/Git/file ops; questions the injected memories already answer; a skill run that names its own inputs; anything mechanical and self-contained. Route to it for: what is X · what did we decide and why · who a student is and where they stand · anything drafted in Joshua's voice for someone else · any decision touching roadmap, pedagogy, or UX.

**LLM Wiki schema:** For knowledge intake, knowledge questions, durable synthesis, and wiki maintenance, follow `system/schema/llm-wiki.md`. Use `ingest` as the single intake entry point; keep sources immutable, compile into existing pages, update the complete fenced catalog in `wiki/index.md`, and append changes to `wiki/log.md`. Preserve domain homes and live-system authority. Mechanical tasks retain the retrieval exceptions above.

**Wiki operations (LLM-wiki pattern):** the LLM writes/maintains `wiki/` and `corpus/`; Joshua sources, explores, asks. Raw sources are immutable — read, never modify. *Ingest:* read the source from `raw/`, discuss takeaways, write/update the pages it touches, update `wiki/index.md`, append to `wiki/log.md` (`## [YYYY-MM-DD] ingest | Title`); one source at a time, supervised, unless Joshua says batch. *Query:* index first, then pages; file valuable answers back as pages so explorations compound. *Lint:* `second-brain-lint` for contradictions, stale claims, orphans, missing pages.

## Voice

- **No em-dashes, ever.** Joshua never types them; a stray em-dash reads as AI and costs trust.
- **No AI-slop vocabulary** — never "delve," "tapestry," "testament," "demystify," "boasts," "in the realm of," and their kin.
- **Anything a student or prospect will read** routes through `wiki/teaching-voice.md` and is drafted, never sent, unless it is a pre-approved template.
- **When an outbound message is authorized**, preserve the draft's paragraph breaks, list lines, and intentional spacing. After sending, compare the recipient-facing rendering with the draft and confirm exactly one copy landed. Report any mismatch; never resend automatically.
- **Lead with your recommendation, not a menu.** Be decisive; don't over-hedge.
- **Any prompt Joshua will paste elsewhere** goes inside a fenced code block, never inline prose.

## Tools, keys, and secrets

- **The entire secret model is `.env` + `.gitignore`.** The root `.env` (git-ignored — verify with `git check-ignore .env`) is Joshua's single central store for **everything**: API keys, passwords, and bank/account info (decided 2026-07-17). OAuth client secrets live in `~/.config/gws/`, outside the repo. There is no vault, no Keychain, no encrypted store (`records.sparsebundle` is dead) and none is wanted. Never paste a credential into chat — add it to `.env` directly in the editor.
- **Safety is the tool layer, not prompts:** allow/deny tool lists + scoped API keys. Jay 2 acts under its own credentials and never impersonates Joshua.
- **Connected live systems:** Cal.com, Google Calendar, LSAT U Supabase, Stripe, Gmail. Full registry in `connections.md`.
- **Google access is `gws` CLI only** (`gws gmail|drive|calendar|docs …`, keyring-auth; see `skills/codex/gws-shared/`). Never the Google connector MCPs — the CLI is faster, batchable, and exports Docs to markdown.
- **Government IDs stay outside this OS.** Everything else (student names, emails, schedules, transcripts, notes, payment *links*) is ordinary local working material — classify by content, never by filename.
- **Git remote is enabled.** `origin` is GitHub (`vnjkoxpl-42905/ai-os`, decided 2026-09-29). The outer repo never tracks `.env`, `../ai-os-projects/lsatu/` (own repo), runtime logs, or locks. Do not create gitlinks.
- **New laptop restore:** GitHub contains tracked ai-os files and skills. It deliberately excludes `.env`, `raw/`, app repos, credentials, and machine sessions. Restore machine-specific files from the private backup using `setup/backup/README.md` and its `README - START HERE.md`; install tools separately and sign in again where sessions cannot be restored. Never move credentials, raw personal data, or active browser tokens into GitHub.

## Skills

Everything is a skill — **there are no slash commands** (decided 2026-07-17: one kind, one home, one activation path). The catalog at `skills/` and `agents/` is inert storage; nothing auto-loads. An item runs only once **activated by copy** (not symlink) into `.agents/skills/` (Claude: `.claude/skills/`). Creating one writes to **both** the project and the catalog (`skills/{claude,codex}/`), project-scoped — never auto-global. `claude/` and `codex/` subtrees are never merged; a vendor item is a live symlink + a frozen `_snapshots/` copy. `system/scripts/check-skills.sh` validates the model; `skills/INDEX.md` indexes it.

Active in this root. Run `pickup` only when Joshua explicitly asks for it. Do not run it automatically at session start. Use `wrapup` at the end of substantive sessions:

| Skill | Use it when |
|---|---|
| `pickup` / `wrapup` | `pickup` only on Joshua's explicit request / `wrapup` at session end (wrapup persists to the wiki ledgers) |
| `session-handoff` | mid-work context reset near ~250k, or passing work Codex↔Claude — chat-only, writes nothing |
| `audit` | scoring the OS against the Four Cs (structural health, /100) |

When a skill run exposes a gap, improve the skill before moving on. Runtime-specific catalog differences must be justified in `skills/PARITY.md`; undeclared differences are defects.

## Guardrails

- **95% rule.** Make no changes until you are 95% confident what Joshua wants. Ask until you are.
- **Lovable credits require confirmation.** Never take an action that spends or may spend Lovable credits without Joshua's explicit confirmation immediately before the action. Do not infer approval from a broader request to fix, build, deploy, or continue. Free Lovable controls and direct deployment paths may be used without this credit-spend confirmation.
- **Lovable Cloud deploys through Lovable.** LSAT U currently uses a Lovable Cloud-managed backend. Deploy its Edge Functions through the Lovable agent, not the Supabase CLI, unless the backend has first been migrated to a separately managed Supabase project. Confirm this route with Joshua before starting a Lovable deployment.
- **Root stays thin.** Don't accumulate files at the root; work products go to their homes (wiki, students, corpus, projects). Anything left at root gets filed before the session ends.
- **Delegate bulk work.** Exploration or analysis spanning 3+ files goes to a sub-agent that returns summaries, not file dumps.
- **Shell ergonomics.** Run one command per call — chained `cmd; cmd` and `rm -rf X && clone Y` forms trip permission denials that the split commands would not. Never poll with `sleep`. Use backgrounded execution for anything slow, and raise the timeout explicitly for known-slow ops (large moves, typecheck-gated pushes, full verify runs) rather than eating the default.
- **Search before creating.** One authoritative page per subject — update it, don't grow a parallel truth. `wiki/index.md` catalogs every page and updates on every ingest.
- **Preserve provenance and source hashes.** Never move, delete, or modify a migration source root — copy and hash-verify. Never follow a source symlink outside its registered root.
- **Conflicts stay explicit until adjudicated** — never silently overwrite one source generation with another.
- **Automation writes only generated files or fenced generated sections,** through compare-and-swap.
- **Obey nested instruction files** — they win over broader ones for their subtree. LSATU's recovered `CLAUDE.md`/`AGENTS.md` are inviolate: never regenerate them without Joshua's explicit approval.
- **Memory = native automemory.** "Remember that…" writes one fact per file to the native store; `MEMORY.md` indexes it. This file is the rules; memory is learned facts — never mix them. Transcripts and raw captures never auto-promote.
- **Append meaningful system changes** to `wiki/log.md`; log locked decisions to `decisions/log.md`.

## Dual-runtime (Codex + Claude)

- Begin at the Git-root `AGENTS.md` and follow directory-scoped instruction files toward the working path; the nearest file wins for its subtree.
- Keep root instructions inside the runtime byte budget. Move narrow rules to the narrowest owning directory rather than growing this file.
- Activated skills are **copies** in `.agents/skills/` (from `skills/codex/`); agent definitions convert to `.codex/agents/*.toml` with the instructions in `developer_instructions`.
- Claude reads `CLAUDE.md` and never this file. Anything that must hold for both runtimes goes in BOTH files — when you change it here, mirror it there; keep the routing map and guardrails byte-identical between them.
- Activation is unequal by design: Codex reads copies in `.agents/skills/`, Claude reads copies in `.claude/skills/`. Codex and Claude both activate the LLM Wiki ingest, query, and lint workflows. Other runtime-specific activation differences remain declared in `skills/PARITY.md`. Never have separate runtimes writing the same page concurrently.
- Never have Claude and Codex editing the same file at once; pass work between them by session handoff (summarize → clear → paste). At ~250k tokens, hand off rather than riding autocompact.

[{'type': 'input_text', 'text': 'Script completed\nWall time 3.8 seconds\nOutput:\n'}, {'type': 'input_text', 'text': '{"chunk_id":"b88da1","wall_time_seconds":1.7112330999999998,"exit_code":0,"original_token_count":2144,"output":"Warning: truncated output (original token count: 2144)\\nTotal output lines: 100\\n\\n---\\r\\ntitle: Teaching Voice\\r\\ntype: concept\\r\\ntags: [lsat-u, voice, pedagogy, content]\\r\\ncreated: 2026-06-10\\r\\nupdated: 2026-07-18\\r\\nstatus: active\\r\\nsubject: Teaching Voice\\r\\naliases: []\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n# Teaching Voice\\r\\n\\r\\nHow LSAT U sounds, across every surface. This is the canonical voice doc: route all student-facing and brand copy through it. Built from a grill with Joshua (2026-06-13), then tested and enriched against the full corpus of his real correspondence (944 messages he authored, mid-2025 to mid-2026, from the Gmail takeout; 2026-07-18). Claims below marked with a quote are evidenced by that corpus.\\r\\n\\r\\nIt replaces the old two-register / 15-named-tools \\"preserve verbatim\\" profile (deleted 2026-06-10) and folds in the brand/marketing register the earlier draft was missing.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Core voice (every register)\\r\\n\\r\\nThe constant under all three registers below. This is Joshua on the page.\\r\\n\\r\\n- **Quiet authority.** State the value and let it land. Never oversell, never beg, never perform enthusiasm.\\r\\n- **Specific, never generic.** Real scores, the actual skill, the student\'s own history. Praise is a specific observation, not \\"great job.\\"\\r\\n- **Honest about the work, gentle about the person.** Be blunt that the LSAT is hard (\\"expect this to be exhausting and very challenging\\"). Never be blunt about a student\'s shortcomings. Honesty points at the material; warmth points at the person. When someone slips, nudge gently, never accuse.\\r\\n- **Light, grounded metaphor, understated in email.** In his real correspondence the recurring image is quiet: \\"partner with you on your LSAT journey,\\" \\"getting set up,\\" \\"foundational.\\" The vivid images (runway, climb, march toward November, an easy door to walk through) belong to authored teaching and brand copy, not to email. Keep metaphor light and grounded; never float off into abstraction.\\r\\n- **Balanced rhythm.** Short declaratives plus one slightly longer warm beat. Air between ideas. Each idea gets its own line. Real messages are short and single-purpose (median ~280 characters).\\r\\n- **Plain professional diction.** No corporate jargon, no startup hype (\\"unlock,\\" \\"crush,\\" \\"level up,\\" \\"game-changer\\" — \\"crush\\" appears once in 944 messages). Contractions are the norm, not the exception. Exclamation points are genuine, not performed: a warm message often carries one, occasionally more, especially in openers (\\"Sorry for such a long delay!\\"). He is not exclamation-averse.\\r\\n- **Forward-looking.** End on the next step or what\'s ahead.\\r\\n- **No em dashes, ever.** Use periods, colons before lists, the middot (·) as a separator, and numbered steps for procedures.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Openings, closings, and signature phrases\\r\\n\\r\\nThe mechanical fingerprint of his email, from the real corpus. Match these when drafting as Joshua.\\r\\n\\r\\n- **Greeting.** \\"Hi [Name],\\" is the default (used ~519x). \\"Hey [Name],\\" for established/returning students (~229x, warmer). \\"Hello [Name],\\" (~105x) and \\"Dear [Name],\\" (~18x, formal) for first contact or a more formal note.\\r\\n- **Sign-off.** \\"Best,\\" and \\"Best regards,\\" are the workhorses (~360x / ~237x). \\"Thanks,\\" when it\'s a favor or logistics (~146x). \\"Warmly,\\" / \\"Warm regards,\\" (~54x) for a genuinely warm note. \\"Talk soon,\\" (~9x) for someone he\'ll see again soon.\\r\\n- **Signature.** Almost always signed **\\"Joshua\\"** (844 of 944 messages). The name is near-universal; include it.\\r\\n- **Signature phrases (his verbal fingerprint, use naturally, don\'t overuse):** \\"let me know\\" (by far the most common, ~390x), \\"looking forward,\\" \\"I hope\\" / \\"hope all is well\\" / \\"hope you,\\" \\"no worries at all,\\" \\"happy to\\" / \\"more than happy to,\\" \\"just wanted to make sure,\\" \\"make sure,\\" \\"no rush,\\" \\"of course.\\"\\r\\n- **Punctuation he actually uses:** semicolons (correctly, ~41x); ellipses essentially never. (For em-dashes, the hard rule in Core voice governs — never.)\\r\\n\\r\\n## The apology / accountability move\\r\\n\\r\\nOne of his most frequent and characteristic behaviors, and worth naming on its own. When he is late to reply, or missed or mishan…144 tokens truncated…a booking-error reply, edited by Joshua line by line over three drafts and then sent as-is. Use this shape whenever a student hit a bug or a mistake that was his. The sent text is the reference:\\r\\n\\r\\n> Hi Sandra,\\r\\n>\\r\\n> I\'m sorry about this. The error was on my end, not yours.\\r\\n>\\r\\n> To confirm: none of your bookings went through, so nothing is on the calendar yet. The page was showing a few times that the system then refused, and it looks like you landed on those. That is fixed now.\\r\\n>\\r\\n> Your link is the same one as before:\\r\\n> [link]\\r\\n>\\r\\n> Pick any time it shows and it will book. If it\'s easier, just send me the time you were trying for and I\'ll add it to the schedule myself.\\r\\n>\\r\\n> If you run into any other issues, let me know.\\r\\n>\\r\\n> Once again, my apologies.\\r\\n>\\r\\n> Best,\\r\\n> Joshua\\r\\n\\r\\n1. **Apology first, as the opening line.** \\"I\'m sorry about this. The error was on my end, not yours.\\" The ownership sits in the first two sentences, before any explanation.\\r\\n2. **State their position plainly, as a confirmation.** \\"To confirm: none of your bookings went through, so nothing is on the calendar yet.\\" Answer the question they actually asked. Don\'t mention the package or credits unless the situation calls for it.\\r\\n3. **One-sentence explanation, then \\"That is fixed now.\\"** No mechanics, no system names.\\r\\n4. **Hand them the next step, plus the manual fallback.** The link, \\"pick any time it shows and it will book,\\" and the offer to do it by hand: \\"If it\'s easier, just send me the time you were trying for and I\'ll add it to the schedule myself.\\"\\r\\n5. **Invite the next report:** \\"If you run into any other issues, let me know.\\"\\r\\n6. **Close with \\"Once again, my apologies.\\"** then \\"Best,\\" and \\"Joshua\\".\\r\\n\\r\\nCut from the draft, do not reuse:\\r\\n- \\"Sorry for the runaround\\" as a sign-off. The apology opens the email; it is not a closing quip.\\r\\n- \\"You will get a calendar invite with the Google Meet link right after.\\" Do not narrate what the system will send; it reads as a promise about machinery.\\r\\n- \\"You have all 10 sessions\\" / \\"nothing was used from your package.\\" Leave the package out unless it is needed; the reassurance they want is that nothing is booked, not an accounting.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Situational micro-templates\\r\\n\\r\\nVerbatim-grounded reference lines for the situations that recur most. Adapt, never paste blindly.\\r\\n\\r\\n- **Student reschedules / cancels:** low-pressure, no guilt.\\r\\n  > No worries at all. It happens, so please don\'t worry about it. If you would like to reschedule, just let me know.\\r\\n- **He missed / no-showed (approved make-good template):** full ownership, real reason, offer to make it right (see the apology move above). When the cause was an unexpected health issue, the approved shape is: sincerely apologize, state that a serious health scare unexpectedly took him out of commission, offer a **completely free, full LSAT session**, and hand them the complimentary booking link `https://cal.com/joshua-jtx5ud/complimentary-session`. Emphasis stays limited: bold the complimentary offer, italicize the line that one focused session can put points on the board. Legacy sittings are read-only. */\nexport default function PracticeTestRunPage() {\n  const { runId } = useParams<{ runId: string }>();\n  const { user } = useAuth();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [run, setRun] = React.useState<Run | null>();\n  const [protectedRun, setProtectedRun] = React.useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);\n  const [revision, reload] = React.useReducer(n => n + 1, 0);\n  React.useEffect(() => {\n    let active = true;\n    setRun(undefined); setProtectedRun(false); setError(null);\n    if (!user || !runId) { setRun(null); return; }\n    void (async () => {\n      // An unacknowledged create may have no account row yet. 'alert' : undefined}>{error ?? (run ? 'This earlier sitting remains saved. Start a new practice test to use the account-backed clock and section saves.' : 'This exam was not found in your account.')}</p>\n    {error && <Button onClick={reload}>Retry loading account</Button>}\n    <Button onClick={() => navigate('/testing')}>Back to Practice Exams</Button></>;\n}\n'''\np.write_text(header+score+wrapper)\n'@ | python -",workdir:"C:/Users/Joshu/dev/lsatu-connected-experience",max_output_tokens:1000}));

It never falls back to a legacy insert on missing or inactive capability. PracticeTestRun dispatches v1 rows or retained v1 commands before any legacy runner effects mount. Legacy unfinished sittings are explicitly read-only; completed legacy reports remain readable. Owned local history is preserved without automatic backend import.\n\nTimedPracticeTestRun handles confirmed creation, start-leg, claim, break start/pause/resume/finish, heartbeat, abandonment, lost replies, and deliberate rejection archival. Only an acknowledged frozen child checkpoint opens `/testing/test/:runId/lr/:legIndex` or `/testing/test/:runId/rc/:legIndex`. Running break heartbeats use lease/3 capped at 5,000ms. The proposed 30,000ms backend lease comes from the root's reviewed rollout request; this UI does not configure or activate it. Leaving a running clock awaits acknowledged pause. Hidden break tabs attempt a retained pause; interrupted or offline exits remain bounded by the server lease, without a promise of instantaneous offline pause.\n\nAsync UI scope is tied to owner/run and ignores late replies after unmount; retained owner/run commands still settle independently. Optional LR questionStates preserve unanswered timing/flags/eliminations. RC closeout accepts optional analysis separately from scoring. Backend capability activation, deployment, ordinary-account acceptance, and browser/screenshots are the root's remaining verification and rollout gates.\n''';p.write_text(s)\n'@ | python -",workdir:"C:/Users/Joshu/dev/lsatu-connected-experience",max_output_tokens:1000}));

r.legs:=jsonb_set(r.legs,array[r.current_leg::text],r.legs->r.current_leg||jsonb_build_object(\'startedAt\',at_time));\\r\\n    if leg->>\'kind\'=\'lr\' then\\r\\n      source_key:=\'drill::practice-test::\'||r.id||\'::leg-\'||r.current_leg::text;\\r\\n      record_id:=gen_random_uuid()::text;\\r\\n      insert into public.timed_pt_lr_bindings_v1(owner_id,run_id,leg_index,namespace,record_id,source_key,frozen_qids)\\r\\n        values(actor,r.id,r.current_leg,\'practice_sessions\',record_id,source_key,array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(leg->\'qids\')));\\r\\n      insert into public.bootcamp_kv(user_id,table_name,record_id,data)\\r\\n        values(actor,\'practice_sessions\',record_id,jsonb_build_object(\'id\',record_id,\'user_id\',actor,\\r\\n          \'pool_slug\',source_key,\'completion_id\',source_key,\'data_version\',2,\'question_queue\',leg->\'qids\',\\r\\n          \'current_index\',0,\'attempts\',\'[]\'::jsonb,\'status\',\'in_progress\',\'elapsed_ms\',0,\\r\\n          \'timer_mode\',case when r.section_seconds is null then \'unlimited\' else \'custom\' end,\\r\\n          \'timer_custom_minutes\',case when r.section_seconds is null then null else r.section_seconds/60.0 end,\\r\\n          \'started_at\',at_time,\'updated_at\',at_time));\\r\\n    elsif leg->>\'kind\'=\'rc\' then\\r\\n      insert into public.rc_drill_sessions(user_id,config,passage_ids,practice_test_run_id,practice_test_leg)\\r\\n        values(actor,jsonb_build_object(\'practiceTestRunId\',r.id,\'practiceTestLegIndex\',r.current_leg,\\r\\n          \'clockElapsedSeconds\',0,\'currentQuestionIndex\',0,\'lastActiveAt\',at_time,\\r\\n          \'timerSeconds\',r.section_seconds,\'mode\',\'section\'),array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(leg->\'passageIds\')::integer),r.id,r.current_leg)\\r\\n        returning id into rc_id;\\r\\n    else raise exception \'Unsupported manifest leg\' using errcode=\'PT422\'; end if;\\r\\n  elsif op=\'checkpoint\' then\\r\\n    if r.timed_phase<>\'leg-running\' then raise exception \'Checkpoint requires running leg\' using errcode=\'PT409\'; end if;\\r\\n    perform public.timed_pt_save_checkpoint_v1(r,payload,at_time);\\r\\n  elsif op=\'heartbeat\' then\\r\\n    if not running then raise exception \'Heartbeat requires running clock\' using errcode=\'PT409\'; end if;\\r\\n  elsif op=\'pause\' then\\r\\n    if r.timed_phase=\'leg-running\' then r.timed_phase:=\'leg-paused\';\\r\\n    elsif r.timed_phase=\'break-running\' then r.timed_phase:=\'break-paused\';\\r\\n    else raise exception \'Clock is not running\' using errcode=\'PT409\'; end if;\\r\\n  elsif op=\'resume\' then\\r\\n    if r.timed_phase=\'leg-paused\' then r.timed_phase:=\'leg-running\';\\r\\n    elsif r.timed_phase=\'break-paused\' then r.timed_phase:=\'break-running\';\\r\\n    else raise exception \'Clock is not paused\' using errcode=\'PT409\'; end if;\\r\\n  elsif op=\'close-leg\' then\\r\\n    if r.timed_phase not in (\'leg-running\',\'leg-paused\') then raise exception \'Leg cannot close\' using errcode=\'PT409\'; end if;\\r\\n    result:=result||public.timed_pt_close_leg_v1(r,payload,at_time);\\r\\n    old_leg:=r.current_leg; next_leg:=old_leg+1;\\r\\n    r.legs:=jsonb_set(r.legs,array[old_leg::text],r.legs->old_leg||jsonb_build_object(\'completedAt\',at_time,\\r\\n      \'correct\',result->\'correct\',\'answered\',result->\'answered\',\'timeMs\',result->\'timeMs\'));\\r\\n"}'}]

## Tool: exec

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"@'\nfrom pathlib import Path\nPath('scripts/verification/timed-pt-live.mjs').write_text(r'''// Ordinary authenticated v1 acceptance on explicitly labelled, newly created QA parents.\n// Does not deploy/activate, delete, grade with AI, send notifications, or adopt legacy work.\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport { readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport { randomUUID, createHash } from 'node:crypto';\nimport { resolve } from 'node:path';\nimport { setTimeout as wait } from 'node:timers/promises';\nimport { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';\n\nconst args = process.argv.slice(2);\nif (!args.includes('--execute')) {\n  console.log('Prepared only. Execute after capability activation: node scripts/verification/timed-pt-live.mjs <central-credentials.env> <evidence.json> --execute');\n  process.exit(0);\n}\nconst [credentialPath, evidencePath] = args.filter(value => !value.startsWith('--'));\nassert.ok(credentialPath && evidencePath, 'Provide credentials and evidence paths');\nconst parseEnv = text => Object.fromEntries(text.split(/\\r?\\n/).flatMap(line => {\n  const match = line.match(/^\\s*([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*)\\s*=\\s*(.*?)\\s*$/);\n  return match ? [[match[1], match[2].replace(/^([\"'])(.*)\\1$/, '$2')]] : [];\n}));\nconst credentials = parseEnv(await readFile(resolve(credentialPath), 'utf8'));\nconst env = parseEnv(await readFile(resolve('.env'), 'utf8'));\nconst key = env.VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY;\nassert.ok(key && env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL, 'Public application connection required');\nif (!key.startsWith('sb_publishable_')) assert.equal(JSON.parse(Buffer.from(key.split('.')[1], 'base64url')).role, 'anon', 'Only public application key permitted');\nconst artifact = JSON.parse(await readFile('docs/implementation-plans/artifacts/timed-content-manifest-v1.generated.json', 'utf8'));\nconst bank = JSON.parse(await readFile('public/data/_bank.generated.json', 'utf8'));\nconst lrKeys = new Map(bank.flatMap(section => section.questions.map(q => [`${q.practiceTest}-S${q.sectionNumber}-Q${q.questionNumber}`, q.correctAnswer])));\nconst evidence = { date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), ordinaryJwt: true, fixtureLabel: '[Verification only] Timed PrepTest atomic v1', fixtureIds: {}, checks: [], profileRestored: null, notifications: 0, gradingRequests: 0, deletes: 0, preExistingRowsModified: 0, passed: false };\nlet student, second, admin, originalFlag, flagChanged = false, stage = 'authentication';\nconst check = label => evidence.checks.push(label);\nconst saveEvidence = () => writeFile(resolve(evidencePath), JSON.stringify(evidence, null, 2) + '\\n');\nasync function login(prefix) {\n  const client = createClient(env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL, key, { auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false } });\n  const { data, error } = await client.auth.signInWithPassword({ email: credentials[`${prefix}_EMAIL`], password: [REDACTED]}_PASSWORD`] });\n  assert.ok(!error && data.user, 'Ordinary password authentication failed');\n  return { client, id: data.user.id };\n}\nconst hash = value => createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(value)).digest('hex');\nasync function rows(client, table, field, value) {\n  const response = await client.from(table).select('*').eq(field, value);\n  assert.ok(!response.error, `Read failed for ${table}: ${response.error?.code ?? ''}`);\n  return response.data;\n}\nasync function rpc(client, command, expectedError) {\n  const name = command.operation === 'create' ? 'create_timed_practice_test_v1' : 'commit_timed_work_v1';\n  const response = await client.rpc(name, { p_command: command });\n  if (expectedError) { assert.equal(response.error?.code, expectedError, `Expected ${expectedError} for ${command.operation}`); return null; }\n  assert.ok(!response.error, `${command.operation} rejected: ${response.error?.code ?? ''}`);\n  const result = response.data;\n  assert.equal(result.receipt.commandId, command.commandId);\n  assert.deepEqual(result.receipt.command, command);\n  assert.equal(result.receipt.ownerId, (await client.auth.getUser()).data.user.id);\n  assert.equal(result.receipt.workId, command.workId);\n  assert.equal(result.parent.id, command.workId);\n  assert.equal(result.parent.timed_contract_version, 1);\n  assert.ok(result.parent.revision >= result.receipt.committedRevision);\n  assert.ok(Number.isFinite(Date.parse(result.serverTime)));\n  return result;\n}\nasync function read(client, id, expectedError) {\n  const response = await client.rpc('read_timed_practice_test_v1', { p_work_id: id });\n  if (expectedError) { assert.equal(response.error?.code, expectedError, 'Owner-only read denial'); return null; }\n  assert.ok(!response.error, `Protected read rejected: ${response.error?.code ?? ''}`);\n  assert.equal(response.data.parent.id, id);\n  return response.data;\n}\nfunction command(parent, operation, payload = {}, deviceId = evidence.deviceB, commandId = randomUUID()) {\n  return { workKind: 'practice-test', workId: parent.id, commandId, deviceId, expectedRevision: parent.revision, writerEpoch: parent.timed_writer_epoch, operation, payload };\n}\nfunction creation(id, pt, deviceId) { return { workKind: 'practice-test', workId: id, commandId: randomUUID(), deviceId, expectedRevision: 0, writerEpoch: 0, operation: 'create', payload: { pt, pace: 'standard', sectionSeconds: 2100 } }; }\nasync function deniedDirect(client, table, values, field, value) {\n  const response = await client.from(table).update(values).eq(field, value).select('*');\n  assert.ok(response.error?.code === '42501' || (!response.error && response.data.length === 0), `Protected raw ${table} write must be denied`);\n}\ntry {\n  student = await login('LSATPREP_TESTER'); second = await login('LSATPREP_TESTER'); admin = await login('LSATPREP_ADMIN');\n  assert.equal(student.id, second.id); assert.notEqual(student.id, admin.id);\n  assert.ok(!(await rows(student.client, 'user_roles', 'user_id', student.id)).some(row => row.role === 'admin'));\n  assert.ok((await rows(admin.client, 'user_roles', 'user_id', admin.id)).some(row => row.role === 'admin'));\n  stage = 'capability';\n  const cap = await student.client.rpc('timed_practice_test_capability_v1');\n  assert.ok(!cap.error && cap.data.enabled === true && cap.data.contractVersion === 1 && cap.data.workKind === 'practice-test', 'Root must enable reviewed capability before execution');\n  for (const op of ['read', 'create', 'claim', 'start-leg', 'checkpoint', 'heartbeat', 'pause', 'resume', 'close-leg', 'start-break', 'finish-break', 'abandon']) assert.ok(cap.data.operations.includes(op), `Missing ${op}`);\n  check('ordinary student/admin actors; active exact v1 capability');\n  // Snapshot existing work and reject occupied content before any writes. Mandatory WAJ is keyed by owner/qid.\n  stage = 'preservation preflight';\n  const filters = { practice_test_runs: 'user_id', attempts: 'user_id', bootcamp_kv: 'user_id', section_history: 'user_id', rc_drill_sessions: 'user_id', rc_attempts: 'user_id', wrong_answer_journal: 'class_id' };\n  const baseline = {};\n  for (const [table, field] of Object.entries(filters)) baseline[table] = await rows(admin.client, table, field, student.id);\n  const assignments = await rows(admin.client, 'practice_test_assignments', 'student_id', student.id);\n  const occupiedQids = new Set([...baseline.attempts, ...baseline.wrong_answer_journal].map(row => row.qid));\n  const occupiedPts = new Set([...baseline.practice_test_runs, ...baseline.section_history, ...assignments].map(row => row.pt));\n  const blueprint = artifact.blueprints.find(test => test.legs[0].kind === 'lr' && test.legs.some(leg => leg.kind === 'rc') && !occupiedPts.has(test.pt) && test.legs.filter(leg => leg.kind === 'lr').every(leg => leg.qids.every(qid => !occupiedQids.has(qid))));\n  assert.ok(blueprint, 'No untouched real PrepTest content is available for tester QA; no writes performed');\n  for (const leg of blueprint.legs.filter(value => value.kind === 'lr')) for (const qid of leg.qids) assert.match(lrKeys.get(qid) ?? '', /^[A-E]$/, 'Frozen LR content must have a local client-derived answer key');\n  const rcBank = JSON.parse(await readFile(`public/data/rc/RC-PT${blueprint.pt}.json`, 'utf8'));\n  const rcKeys = new Map(rcBank.passages.flatMap(passage => passage.questions.map(q => [q.questionId, q.correctAnswer])));\n  const profile = await admin.client.from('profiles').select('class_id,has_practice_access').eq('class_id', student.id).single();\n  assert.ok(!profile.error && typeof profile.data.has_practice_access === 'boolean', 'Tester profile must be readable');\n  originalFlag = profile.data.has_practice_access;\n  assert.equal(originalFlag, true, 'Tester needs an existing practice grant; probe never grants new access');\n  evidence.fixtureIds = { studentParent: `qa-timed-v1-${randomUUID()}`, adminParent: `qa-timed-v1-${randomUUID()}` };\n  evidence.deviceA = `qa-device-a-${randomUUID()}`; evidence.deviceB = `qa-device-b-${randomUUID()}`;\n  evidence.pt = blueprint.pt; evidence.manifestSha256 = artifact.manifestSha256; evidence.originalPracticeFlag = originalFlag;\n  evidence.preExistingSnapshots = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(baseline).map(([table, values]) => [table, { count: values.length, sha256: hash(values) }]));\n  await saveEvidence();\n  stage = 'dedicated creation and cross-owner denial';\n  let current = await rpc(student.client, creation(evidence.fixtureIds.studentParent, blueprint.pt, evidence.deviceA));\n  assert.equal(current.parent.timed_manifest_sha256, artifact.manifestSha256); assert.deepEqual(current.parent.timed_manifest, blueprint);\n  const adminWork = await rpc(admin.client, creation(evidence.fixtureIds.adminParent, blueprint.pt, `qa-admin-${randomUUID()}`));\n  await read(student.client, adminWork.parent.id, 'PT401');\n  await rpc(student.client, command(adminWork.parent, 'abandon'), 'PT401');\n  await rpc(admin.client, command(adminWork.parent, 'abandon', {}, adminWork.parent.active_device_id));\n  check('two dedicated QA parents; student read/command cross-owner denied; admin QA retained abandoned');\n  stage = 'start/checkpoint discarded response and replay';\n  current = await rpc(student.client, command(current.parent, 'start-leg', {}, evidence.deviceA));\n  const firstLeg = current.parent.timed_manifest.legs[0], firstQid = firstLeg.qids[0];\n  const wrong = lrKeys.get(firstQid) === 'A' ? 'B' : 'A';\n  const firstAnswer = { qid: firstQid, selected: wrong, correct: false, timeMs: 100, flagged: false };\n  const retained = command(current.parent, 'checkpoint', { currentIndex: 1, answers: [firstAnswer] }, evidence.deviceA);\n  // Commit, deliberately discard the returned authority, then recover through independent account read.\n  // This is lost-application-reply evidence, not a claim that the TCP request was physically interrupted.\n  await rpc(student.client, retained);\n  current = await read(second.client, current.parent.id);\n  current = await rpc(student.client, command(current.parent, 'heartbeat', {}, evidence.deviceA));\n  const replay = await rpc(second.client, retained);\n  assert.equal(replay.replayed, true); assert.deepEqual(replay.parent, current.parent);\n  assert.ok(replay.parent.revision > replay.receipt.committedRevision);\n  await rpc(student.client, { ...retained, payload: { ...retained.payload, currentIndex: 0 } }, 'PT412');\n  assert.equal(replay.checkpoint.record.attempts.length, 1);\n  check('discarded application reply; exact UUID/envelope replay returns current authority; changed payload PT412');\n  stage = 'live lease and expired takeover';\n  await rpc(second.client, command(current.parent, 'claim', {}, evidence.deviceB), 'PT409');\n  const remaining = Date.parse(current.parent.timed_lease_expires_at) - Date.parse(current.serverTime);\n  assert.ok(remaining > 0 && remaining <= 35000, 'Acceptance expects reviewed lease at most 35 seconds');\n  await wait(remaining + 1200);\n  await rpc(student.client, command(current.parent, 'heartbeat', {}, evidence.deviceA), 'PT410');\n  const beforeClaim = current.parent;\n  current = await rpc(second.client, command(current.parent, 'claim'));\n  assert.equal(current.parent.timed_phase, 'leg-paused'); assert.equal(current.parent.timed_writer_epoch, beforeClaim.timed_writer_epoch + 1);\n  assert.ok(current.parent.timed_elapsed_ms <= beforeClaim.timed_elapsed_ms + remaining + 50, 'Server settles no further than acknowledged lease');\n  await rpc(student.client, { ...command(current.parent, 'resume', {}, evidence.deviceA), writerEpoch: beforeClaim.timed_writer_epoch }, 'PT409');\n  current = await rpc(second.client, command(current.parent, 'resume'));\n  const concurrent = await Promise.all(['a', 'b'].map(() => second.client.rpc('commit_timed_work_v1', { p_command: command(current.parent, 'heartbeat') })));\n  assert.equal(concurrent.filter(value => !value.error).length, 1); assert.equal(concurrent.find(value => value.error)?.error.code, 'PT409');\n  current = concurrent.find(value => !value.error).data;\n  check('live foreign claim denied; real expired lease PT410; takeover epoch increments; stale epoch and concurrent CAS denied');\n  stage = 'tester-only access revocation';\n  flagChanged = true; // Set before request so even a lost admin reply causes an exact restore attempt.\n  const revoked = await admin.client.from('profiles').update({ has_practice_access: false }).eq('class_id', student.id).select('has_practice_access').single();\n  assert.ok(!revoked.error && revoked.data.has_practice_access === false, 'Tester-only grant revoke failed');\n  await rpc(second.client, command(current.parent, 'pause'), 'PT401');\n  const preservedRead = await read(second.client, current.parent.id); assert.deepEqual(preservedRead.parent, current.parent);\n  const restored = await admin.client.from('profiles').update({ has_practice_access: originalFlag }).eq('class_id', student.id).select('has_practice_access').single();\n  assert.ok(!restored.error && restored.data.has_practice_access === originalFlag, 'Tester grant restore failed'); flagChanged = false; evidence.profileRestored = true;\n  check('tester-only access revoke denies writes and preserves owner history; exact original flag restored');\n  stage = 'official frozen legs and mandatory closeout';\n  for (let index = 0; index < blueprint.legs.length; index++) {\n    if (index !== 0) current = await rpc(second.client, command(current.parent, 'start-leg'));\n    const leg = current.parent.timed_manifest.legs[index]; assert.equal(current.parent.current_leg, index);\n    if (leg.kind === 'lr') {\n      const qid = leg.qids[0], correctAnswer = lrKeys.get(qid);\n      const answer = { qid, selected: correctAnswer === 'A' ? 'B' : 'A', correct: false, timeMs: index === 0 ? 200 : 100, flagged: true };\n      current = await rpc(second.client, command(current.parent, 'checkpoint', { currentIndex: 1, answers: [answer], questionStates: [{ qid: leg.qids[1], timeMs: 75, flagged: true, eliminations: ['E'] }] }));\n      const reloaded = await read(second.client, current.parent.id);\n      assert.ok(reloaded.checkpoint.record.question_states.some(value => value.qid === leg.qids[1] && value.flagged));\n      const binding = reloaded.checkpoint.record;\n      await deniedDirect(student.client, 'bootcamp_kv', { data: { ...binding, status: 'completed' } }, 'record_id', binding.id);\n      await rpc(second.client, command(current.parent, 'close-leg', { answerKeys: [] }), 'PT422');\n      current = await rpc(second.client, command(current.parent, 'close-leg', { answerKeys: leg.qids.map(qid => ({ qid, correctAnswer: lrKeys.get(qid) })), analysis: { verification_only: true } }));\n      const histories = await rows(student.client, 'section_history', 'practice_test_run_id', current.parent.id);\n      const history = histories.find(row => row.practice_test_leg === index);\n      assert.ok(history && history.initial_total === leg.questionCount && history.unanswered_count === leg.questionCount - 1);\n      const attempts = await rows(student.client, 'attempts', 'timed_pt_run_id', current.parent.id);\n      assert.equal(attempts.filter(row => row.timed_pt_leg === index).length, 1);\n      const waj = await rows(admin.client, 'wrong_answer_journal', 'class_id', student.id);\n      assert.ok(leg.qids.every(qid => waj.some(row => row.qid === qid && row.history_json.length === 1)));\n      check(`LR leg ${index}: saved unanswered states; legacy KV blocked; mandatory full-key/history/attempt/WAJ closeout`);\n    } else {\n      const q = leg.questions[0], key = rcKeys.get(q.questionId); assert.match(key ?? '', /^[A-E]$/);\n      const answer = { attemptId: randomUUID(), questionId: q.questionId, passageId: q.passageId, selected: key === 'A' ? 'B' : 'A', isCorrect: false, timeMs: 100, flagged: false, eliminations: [] };\n      current = await rpc(second.client, command(current.parent, 'checkpoint', { currentIndex: 0, answers: [answer] }));\n      const changed = { ...answer, selected: key, isCorrect: true, timeMs: 200, flagged: true, eliminations: [key === 'A' ? 'B' : 'A'] };\n      current = await rpc(second.client, command(current.parent, 'checkpoint', { currentIndex: 1, answers: [changed] }));\n      const reloaded = await read(second.client, current.parent.id);\n      assert.equal(reloaded.checkpoint.attempts.find(value => value.id === answer.attemptId).selected, key);\n      await deniedDirect(student.client, 'rc_attempts', { selected: answer.selected }, 'id', answer.attemptId);\n      const sessionId = reloaded.checkpoint.session.id;\n      current = await rpc(second.client, command(current.parent, 'close-leg', { analysis: { verification_only: true } }));\n      const attempts = await rows(student.client, 'rc_attempts', 'session_id', sessionId);\n      assert.equal(attempts.length, leg.questionCount); assert.equal(attempts.filter(value => value.selected !== null).length, 1);\n      const sessions = await rows(student.client, 'rc_drill_sessions', 'id', sessionId);\n      assert.equal(sessions[0].status, 'completed'); assert.equal(sessions[0].config.analysis.verification_only, true);\n      check(`RC leg ${index}: mutable choice stable UUID; reload; raw attempt blocked; blanks and analysis closeout`);\n    }\n    if (current.parent.current_leg === current.parent.break_after_leg && !current.parent.break_taken) {\n      stage = 'break pause and replay';\n      current = await rpc(second.client, command(current.parent, 'start-break'));\n      const pause = command(current.parent, 'pause');\n      await rpc(second.client, pause); current = await read(second.client, current.parent.id);\n      const pauseReplay = await rpc(second.client, pause); assert.equal(pauseReplay.replayed, true); assert.deepEqual(pauseReplay.parent, current.parent);\n      assert.equal(current.parent.timed_phase, 'break-paused'); assert.equal(current.parent.timed_lease_expires_at, null);\n      current = await rpc(second.client, command(current.parent, 'resume'));\n      current = await rpc(second.client, command(current.parent, 'heartbeat'));\n      current = await rpc(second.client, command(current.parent, 'finish-break'));\n      assert.equal(current.parent.break_taken, true); check('server break pause, retained same-command retry, resume/heartbeat/finish');\n    }\n  }\n  stage = 'confirmed completion and terminal barriers';\n  assert.equal(current.parent.status, 'complete'); assert.ok(current.parent.completed_at); assert.equal(current.parent.current_leg, blueprint.legs.length);\n  assert.equal(current.parent.raw_correct, 1); assert.equal(current.parent.raw_total, blueprint.questionCount); ## assistant

never as markup.\\r\\n *\\r\\n * The dossier is keyed by `profiles.class_id`; progress tables are keyed by the\\r\\n * auth user id. `students` maps between them, the same join the bootcamp the established pattern in this repo.\\r\\n */\\r\\n// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any\\r\\nconst untypedDb = supabase as any;\\r\\n\\r\\ninterface ProgressRow {\\r\\n auth user id the progress tables use. */\\r\\nfunction useStudentUserId(classId: string | undefined) {\\r\\n  return useQuery<string | null>({\\r\\n    queryKey: [\'dossier-student-user-id\', classId],\\r\\n    enabled: !!classId,\\r\\n    queryFn: async () => {\\r\\n      const { data, error } = await supabase\\r\\n        .from(\'students\')\\r\\n        .select(\'user_id\')\\r\\n        .eq(\'class_id\', classId as string)\\r\\n        .maybeSingle();\\r\\n      if (error) throw error;\\r\\n      if (data?.user_id == null) return null;\\r\\n      if (typeof data.user_id !== useLessonProgress(userId: string | null | undefined) {\\r\\n  return useQueries({\\r\\n    queries: LESSON_PROGRESS_SOURCES.map(source => ({\\r\\n      queryKey: [\'dossier-lesson-progress\', userId, \'lesson_id,data,completed_at,updated_at\'\\r\\n          : \'lesson_id,completed_at\';\\r\\n        let query = untypedDb.from(source.table).select(columns).eq(\'user_id\', userId);\\r\\n        if ## assistant

No files or backend records changed. The next slice should fix evidence diagnostics before adding more sources.

The concrete defects are:

- [studentWorkEvidence.ts:30](C:/Users/Joshu/dev/lsatu-connected-experience/src/lib/studentWorkEvidence.ts:30) silently drops malformed `PracticeSession` rows and identity mismatches.
- [studentWorkEvidence.ts:59](C:/Users/Joshu/dev/lsatu-connected-experience/src/lib/studentWorkEvidence.ts:59) silently drops malformed `drill_runs` and conflicting embedded source bindings.
- [studentWorkEvidence.ts:90](C:/Users/Joshu/dev/lsatu-connected-experience/src/lib/studentWorkEvidence.ts:90) combines both reads with `Promise.all`. A failed run-ledger read also discards independently valid homework and legacy guided evidence.
- Both paginated readers treat a successful `data: null` response as genuine emptiness.
- [useScopedStudentWork.ts:26](C:/Users/Joshu/dev/lsatu-connected-experience/src/hooks/useScopedStudentWork.ts:26) only knows thrown errors. Successful parsing exclusions generate no diagnostic.
- [MyWorkPage.tsx:44](C:/Users/Joshu/dev/lsatu-connected-experience/src/pages/MyWorkPage.tsx:44) and [DossierWork.tsx:99](C:/Users/Joshu/dev/lsatu-connected-experience/src/pages/teacher/students/DossierWork.tsx:99) can consequently label an assignment “Assigned” when its saved progress could not be interpreted.

The smallest implementation is to retain existing `guided`/`homework` maps and add structured diagnostics: source, reason, family, rejected-row count, and affected assignment IDs where ownership and binding can be established safely. Read `practice_sessions` and `drill_runs` independently; preserve valid evidence from either. Treat malformed response shape as a failed source.

Classification must happen before strict session parsing:

| Stored source | Assignment binding |
|---|---|
| `practice_sessions` | `pool_slug === guided::<issued-id>` or `drill::assignment::<issued-id>`; owner, session ID and deterministic record ID must match |
| `drill_runs` | Outer owner/ID plus embedded session; `source_key`, `session.pool_slug` and `completion_id` must agree |
| `activity_item_responses` | Explicit `student_id` plus issued assignment ID |

Direct guided launches (`guided::drill:…`, `guided::slug:…`), official PrepTest/section sessions, other practice namespaces and valid zero-answer sessions remain intentional exclusions. They must not produce assignment warnings. Unclassifiable malformed records should produce a source-level warning without guessing an assignment or exposing raw answers.

For affected rows with no confirmed progress proof, show “Progress unverified” rather than “Assigned”. Preserve known saved answers and timestamp-confirmed completion. A source outage should also suppress claims that an empty list is complete. Retry should clear diagnostics only after a valid reread.

Proposed ownership for implementation:

- `studentWorkEvidence.ts` and tests: classification, diagnostics, independent reads.
- `studentScopedWork.ts` and tests: propagate partial source results.
- `useScopedStudentWork.ts` and tests: named diagnostics and uncertain row status.
- `useAssignedTodoFeed.ts` and tests: same student-facing behavior.
- `MyWorkPage.tsx` and its refetch tests; `DossierWork.tsx` and tests: truthful labels, alerts and retry.
- `HubAssignments.tsx` only if needed to expose scoped Activity-source failures; its current warning excludes those failures, although individual Activity mirrors already display “unverified”.

Meaningful tests should cover valid plus malformed rows, one failed namespace preserving the other, malformed response shape, source-binding conflicts, intentional exclusions, completed-retake precedence, owner changes, and recovery clearing warnings without losing independent saved evidence.

Remaining source families verified from code:

| Family | Existing persisted sources / coverage |
|---|---|
| Issued work | Homework, TA, guided, Activity assignments; classroom mirrors; weekly-plan items |
| LR practice and sections | `attempts`, `section_history`, saved sessions, standalone run ledger |
| RC practice | `rc_drill_sessions`, `rc_attempts`; separate flags/review sources |
| PrepTests | `practice_test_runs` plus LR/RC children; protected v1 and preserved legacy history |

## assistant

The main change is in place: each saved-work source can now fail independently, and rejected assignment records produce diagnostics. Work rows retain valid progress and completion; rows with uncertain evidence get a separate label. I’m adding tests for source failures, malformed records, and excluded practice namespaces.
